name: Heavy Slash
action: Broad physical horizontal sword strike.

name: Impact Wave
action: Upward swing drives a shockwave along the ground.

name: Impact Punch
action: Compact forward armored punch and blunt impact.

name: Moonlight Splitter
action: Three horizontal ghost crescent projectiles; no normal-state fire.

name: Crescent Cleave
action: Five vertical traveling ground cleaves spreading in a fan; no normal-state fire.

name: Blade Storm
action: Three cuts inside a localized spatial sphere; not a tornado.

name: Frenzied Charge
action: Straight sword thrust and forward dash.

name: Eclipse
action: Enlarged magical sword completing a full circular sweep.

name: Halfmoon Slash
action: Huge frontal melee sweep with an afterimage; normal state is not a projectile.

name: Knight’s Guidance
action: Swift armored steps and guiding golden wind: movement and stamina support.

name: Stomp
action: Boot impact and concentric ground aftershocks.

name: Circle Swing
action: Fighter physically swinging a heavy weapon in a full circle.

name: Punishing Bomb
action: Thrown iron bomb exploding against ground; blunt impact with fire.

name: Bonecrusher
action: Armored fighter landing bodily from a jump; no falling summoned hammer.

name: Seismic Guillotine
action: Advancing line of ground fractures ending in an explosion; no guillotine blade.

name: Whirlwind
action: Fighter actively spinning a weapon around their body.

name: Battlecry
action: Roaring fighter with outward rallying sound arcs.

name: Lightning Zap
action: Forward horizontal lightning cone from the caster; not a sky strike.

name: Righteous Strike
action: One vertical lightning pillar striking a ground target.

name: Holy Wave
action: Outward healing wave from a raised hand and caster.

name: Goddess Relic
action: Huge solid upright cross falling into the ground.

name: Judgement Hammer
action: Hammer flies forward horizontally while rotating vertically.

name: Shield Charge
action: Armored fighter rushing forward behind a raised shield.

name: Angel Comet
action: Armored human diving headfirst like a comet; no angel creature.

name: Ray of Hope
action: Raised hand releases a supportive healing and buff wave.

name: Electric Smite
action: Acrobatic landing releases radial lightning trails along the ground, not from the sky.

name: Heaven’s Light
action: Defensive holy blessing surrounds allies.

name: Lightning Relic
action: Planted player-height cross pulsing blue electricity.

name: Holy Relic
action: Planted player-height cross emitting healing rings.

name: Divine Intervention
action: Protective holy burst around allies and a planted cross.

name: Grand Cross
action: Two diagonal slashes form a forward-traveling X, not an upright cross.

name: Heaven’s Judgement
action: Multiple slender straight holy beams bombard a ground circle.

name: Lightning Tempest
action: Multiple jagged vertical sky bolts strike a storm area.

name: Heaven’s Crucible
action: Strong luminous barrier encloses allied silhouettes.

name: Flame Burst
action: Short forward cone of flame from the caster; not a fireball.

name: Glacial Descent
action: Massive chunk of ice descends from above and strikes the ground.

name: Stonefang Eruption
action: Natural jagged stone spikes rise out of the ground.

name: Gravity Dominion
action: Stationary circular gravity field pulls matter inward; not a traveling orb.

name: Astral Greatblade
action: Giant purple spectral sword extends from the casting weapon and slams down.

name: Frost Nova
action: Radial frost burst around the caster; not falling ice.

name: Meteor Fall
action: Single fiery rock descends onto a ground target; normal state has no secondary meteors.

name: Astral Railcannon
action: Directed energy beam focused through rotating arcane rings; no mechanical cannon.

name: Elemental Cataclysm
action: Large multielement ground detonation, visually broader than Meteor Fall.

name: Clockwork
action: Clock face and time-magic rings communicate cooldown support.

name: Rift Echo
action: Portal behind an enemy fires a copied shot toward their back.

name: Void Step
action: Caster disappears and reappears between two spatial tears.

name: Arcane Phalanx
action: Four spectral swords hover around a mobile caster in the normal state.

name: Afterimage Arsenal
action: Matching astral copies of the caster; normal copies are stationary, not followers.

name: Gravity Blast
action: Traveling dark gravity orb with horizontal motion, distinct from Dominion.

name: Arcane Rupture
action: Localized spatial detonation over a circular ground target.

name: Rift Walker
action: Two linked traversal portals.
